DOP: bhāyati bheti ( and bhāti 2 ?), pr. 3 sg. [ S. √bhī, bibheti], fears; is afraid (of, abl., gen. or acc.); is anxious about; Vin II 185, 10 (Devadatto Ajātasattuṃ kumāraṃ etad avoca ~asi maṃ tvaṃ kumārā ti); S I 18, 19* (jighacchā ca pipāsā ca yassa ~ati maccharī tam eva bālaṃ phusati); 43, 3* (dhamme ṭhito paralokaṃ na ~e); 111, 2* (jaggaṃ na saṅke na pi bhemi sottuṃ; Spk I 176, 28 : ahaṃ supituṃ pi na ~āmi); Dhp 129 (sabbe ~anti maccuno); Ud 33, 1 (yassa ~ati taṃ dukkhaṃ); 51, 9 (~atha vo tumhe kumārakā dukkhassa appiyaṃ vo dukkhan ti; Ud-a 294, 27 foll.: ettha vo ti nipātamattaṃ, dukkhassā ti nissakke sāmivacanaṃ, dukkhasmā ti attho); Sn 964 (pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na ~e); Thī 230 (bāle na tvaṃ ~asi dhuttakānaṃ); Ja I 274, 16 (kasmā nu kho tvaṃ māṇava maraṇabhayaṃ na ~asī ti); IV 163, 11* (mā bhetha kiṃ socatha); 416, 8´ (mātugāmo nāma appamattakena pi ~ati); V 497, 6 (mā ~athā ti aññamaññaṃ samassāsesuṃ); Nidd I 217, 15 (na uttasati na paritassati na ~ati); Bv 2:172 (vissatthā hotha mā bhātha imasmiṃ paṭhavikampane, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhetha; Bv-a 116, 25 : mā ~atha) = Ja I 26, 24* ; Cp 3:13:3 (na maṃ koci uttasati na pi ~āmi kassaci); Mil 208, 20 (yena pana mahārāja hetunā arahanto ~eyyuṃ … so hetu arahantānaṃ samucchinno); Vism 417, 29 (te andhakāraṃ disvā ~anti); Ps II 385, 8 (puthujjano catuhi pi bhayehi ~ati); Pj II 125, 3 (sīho kira na kassaci ~atī ti); Mhv 7:60 (manussā amanussehi ~anti hi sadā); — part.pr. ( a ) bhāyanta, mfn. , Ja III 35, 21´ ; Mil 149, 6 (yo ca mahārāja kaṇhasappassa ~ati so maraṇassa ~anto kaṇhasappassa ~ati); Cp-a 269, 6 ; — neg. abhāyanta, mfn. , Ja II 421, 29´ ; VI 305, 9 ; Dhp-a I 130, 20 (maraṇassa abhāyanto nāma natthī ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se abhāyanakasatto); ( b ) bhāyamāna, mfn. , Ja III 35, 19´ ; IV 79, 26 (so bhātu antepure dubbhitvā ~amāno palāyitvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee gayhamāno); Spk II 300, 12 ; Ud-a 163, 1 (pararājūhi ~amāno); — bhāyamānā in Ee at S V 448, 2 is perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se mohayamānā; — neg. abhāyamāna, mfn. , Ps III 314, 19 ; Spk II 142, 12 ; — aor. 3 sg. bhāyi, M I 306, 9 (mā bhavaṃ ~i); 2 sg. bhāyi, D I 50, 8 (mā ~i mahārāja, na taṃ deva vañcemi); Vv 24:16 (mā tvaṃ Uposathe ~i); Ja I 222, 26 ; 2 pl. bhāyittha, A IV 88, 29 (mā bhikkhave puññānaṃ ~ittha); Mil 275, 14 (so dārake … mā ~itthā ti na assāsesi); — absol. bhāyitvā, Ja III 61, 15 (~itvā palāto bhavissatī ti); IV 312, 13 (isīhi pana sapathe kate Sakko ~itvā … anantaragātham āha, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee mā bhāyittha); Mil 27, 17 (kassa pana tvaṃ ~itvā musā bhāsasi); Dhp-a II 6, 13 (lābhasakkāro me parihāyissatī ti ~itvā); Mhv 36:83 ( Be so; Ee bhāsitvā); — neg. abhāyitvā, Ja II 126, 13´ ; Ps III 159, 11 ; — pp bhīta , mfn. [ ts ], frightened, afraid; apprehensive; Vin II 185, 8 (Ajātasattukumāro ~o ahosi ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto); 207, 12 (ahi khandhe papati so ~o vissaraṃ akāsi); D I 50, 1 (~o saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto); S IV 173, 8 (puriso ~o catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ); A II 121, 25 (so attānuvādabhayassa ~o); Dhp 310 (~assa ~āya ratī pi thokikā); Th 706 (tassa te natthi ~-ttaṃ); Thī 237 (kassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ ~o sadā udakam otari); Ja II 10, 28* (ehi sīha nivattassu kiṃ nu ~o palāyasi); III 184, 11 (so … baddharāvaṃ ravi, taṃ sutvā ~ā migagaṇā palāyiṃsu); V 209, 12 (yakkhinī kira sā ti ~o); 373, 12* (parisaṃ patto bhayā ~o no bhāsasi); VI 17, 1* (tassa rajjass’ ahaṃ ~o mā maṃ rajjābhisecayuṃ); 172, 8* (yamunaṃ pavisa mā ~o; 172, 13´ : abhīto hutvā pavisa); 524, 15* (tato so brāhmaṇo ~o brāhmaṇiyā vasānugo); Ap 467, 1 (~ānaṃ saraṇo muni); Cp 2:6:6 (dhanikehi ~o tasito); Mil 390, 5 (suriyo rāhubhayā ~o carati); Vism 381, 7 (te therassa calanākāraṃ disvā ~ā viraviṃsu); Ps V 88, 21 (~ā manussā attano attano devatā namassanti); Ud-a 328, 23 (~assa udānaṃ nāma natthī ti); Mhv 32:68 (~o maccubhayā); — ifc see kiṃ- ( sv ka 3 ); — abhīta, mfn. , without fear (of); fearless; Vin I 25, 23* (abhīto pāvisi bhayam atīto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee asambhīto); Ud 19, 31 (abhīto anubbiggo); Th 482; Ja III 204, 12 (abhītā tuṭṭhindriyā); Ap 361, 24 ; Sv 558, 9 (abhīto va āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji); Ps III 176, 10 (imasmiṃ sāsane cattāri bhayāni, yo tāni abhīto so … patiṭṭhātuṃ sakkoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee adhibhoti); — atibhīta, mfn. , very frightened; Ja V 144, 19´ (tassa atibhītabhāvaṃ ñatvā mahāsatto taṃ nirayaṃ antaradhāpesi, Ce, Se so; Be ativiya bhītabhāvaṃ; Ee wr atītabhāvaṃ); Mhv 4:39 (atibhīto ahū rājā); — nibbhīta, nibhīta, mfn. [ S. nirbhīta], without fear, not afraid; Ap-a 216, 10 (kumbhilādayo macchā nibbhītā nirupaddavā vasantī ti); 536, 2* (vyagghā … nibbhītā yena kenaci, Be, Se so; Ee nibhītā; not in Ce ); — fpp bhāyitabba , mfn. and n. , impers. , (what is) to be feared; one must be afraid (of); M I 454, 15 (~aṃ etassa sukhassā ti vadāmi); Ja V 373, 26* (~aṃ na bhāyasi); Dhp-a III 23, 21 (bhayan ti ~aṃ … sappaṭibhayan ti attho); It-a II 38, 12 (~aṃ etasmā ti taṃ ummi bhayaṃ); 64, 29 (tesaṃ ~-taṃ passitvā); Cp-a 220, 6 (ito … satasahassaguṇena nirayo ~o ti); — neg. abhāyitabba, mfn. , Spk II 276, 3 (abhāyitabbe ṭhānamhi); Pj II 317, 5 (cattāro kira abhāyitabbaṃ bhāyanti, gaṇḍuppādo kikī kontanī brāhmaṇo ti); — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( a ) bhāyeti , ~ayati , Ja III 99, 14* (muhuṃ muhuṃ ~ayate kumāre; 99, 17´ : rājakumāre utrāseti); 210, 3* (idāni kho maṃ ~eti mahānerunidassanaṃ, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se bhāyati; 210, 6´ : ayaṃ nigrodho … idāni maṃ bhāyāpeti santāseti); Sadd 407, 6 (kārite ~eti ~ayati); — absol. bhāyetvā, Ja IV 181, 19 (mahājanaṃ ~etvā tāsetvā); Dhp-a I 124, 1 (anicchantaṃ ~etvā naṃ nessāmī ti, Ce, Se so; Be paribhāsetvā; Ee bhasetvā); — ( b ) bhāyāpeti , ~ayati , Ja II 142, 26 (jiṇṇamātugāme … ~eti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se gāyāpeti); III 210, 6´ (maṃ ~eti santāseti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~eti santajjeti); Sadd 407, 7 (~eti ~ayati); — aor. 3 sg. bhāyāpesi, Ja III 99, 21 ; V 300, 13 (mahantena saddena taṃ ~esi); — absol. bhāyāpetvā, Ja III 34, 17 (naṃ … ~etvā palāpesi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhayāpetvā).
